arxiv-2205-03548.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Nouman Butt, Xiao-Yong Jin, James C. Osborn, Zain H. Saleem. We study the effects of discretization on the U(1) symmetric XY model in two dimensions using the Higher Order Tensor Renormalization Group (HOTRG) approach. Regarding the Z N Z_{N} symmetric clock models as specific discretizations of the XY model, we compare those discretizations to ones from truncations of the tensor network formulation of the XY model based on a character expansion, and focus on the differences in their phase structure at low temperatures.
